provider: KUB.ua File Cloud (Ukraine) — Nextcloud-backed flat per-TB with unlimited traffic

free_tier.stated: FILE CLOUD 1: 869.57 ₴/mo for 1 TB; FILE CLOUD 5: 1,840.36 ₴/mo for 5 TB. Unlimited users, unlimited traffic, 50 concurrent connections, 7-day trial, Nextcloud platform.

egress.terms: «Трафік не обмежений» (traffic unlimited), stated in the plan table. No meter or overage rate on the page.

tooling: Nextcloud — so WebDAV, and with the Nextcloud desktop client or rclone `webdav`. Nextcloud's own S3-primary-object-store is configurable only server-side, so from the client's side this is WebDAV.
chaining: Two sizes on the public page (1 TB, 5 TB); 20 TB needs a sales conversation. 5 TB is the only competitive point.
limits_note: 50 concurrent connections at 1 TB. The 1 TB tier is poor value ($19.28/TB); the product only becomes interesting at 5 TB ($8.16/TB).
reliability_note: Nextcloud-on-managed-infrastructure; the vendor's own platform claim, no independent benchmark. Business-oriented (rights management, backup) rather than storage-farm. The per-TB discount from 1 TB to 5 TB is 2.36×, which is unusually steep and suggests the 1 TB price is a headline rather than a rate.

evidence.proved: «FILE CLOUD 1 869.57₴/міс — Дисковий простір 1 Tb — Користувачів необмежено — Трафік не обмежений — Одночасні підключення: 50 — Платформа Nextcloud»; «FILE CLOUD 5 1840.36₴/міс — Дисковий простір 5 Tb»; «Тестовий період 7 днів»
snippet surfaced «kub.ua/file-cloud — FILE CLOUD 1 869.57₴/міс … Трафік не обмежений», which is what prompted opening the page

price_per_tb_month: $8.16/TB/mo at 5 TB ($40.81/mo), $19.28/TB/mo at 1 TB ($19.28/mo). At 20 TB: $8.16/TB/mo if 4× the 5 TB plan is allowed, derived. UAH at 0.022177 USD/UAH. Egress $0.
